snippet.title: Whisper Mountain Outbreak - October Update Trailer
snippet.description:
NEW UPDATE COMING THIS OCTOBER!

Whisper Mountain Outbreak is a PvE survival game set in a remote town haunted by ancient supernatural forces. As a secret government agent, explore cursed locations, solve challenging puzzles, and battle terrifying creatures. Choose your specialization, manage resources, and uncover the dark mystery beneath Mount Bisik. Will your team survive the outbreak... or be consumed by it?

The October upcoming updates include:
🧭 Roguelike Map
🧪 Map Modifiers
🧢 Character Customization
...and more!

Now available on Steam!
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953230/Whisper_Mountain_Outbreak/
